Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''Zygerrian''' was working as a guard in a slave pit on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]].

==Biography==
Following a [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|mission]] to infiltrate the [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] on Zygerria, [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] arrived at a slave pit to rescue the [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] governor of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]], but the rescue attempt fails when Obi-Wan was spotted and shot down by Zygerrian guards. Obi-Wan was then chained to a wall and this guard tortured him with a [[Shock whip]] to make him talk. The torture was momentarily stopped when the the Zygerrian supervisor, [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]] arrived to see if the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] has said anything. This guard then continued to whip Obi-Wan until Atai Molec realized who the Jedi actually was.
